_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. The notices list (Сповіщення: its button, Очистити все, Перечитати and Залишити мою, the strip under a song changed outside), and everything put in a notice or a refusal cue: imports, song packs and bundles (both пакет пісень, as the import menu says), presentations, themes and versions, the library's moves and saves, errors shown in the window, the Settings and Screens windows' titles. The language names (notices.catalog.lang.*) are only ever said as «пісні {language}», so they are written in the instrumental (українською, англійською). Counts given by tf (no plural form) are put after a colon or in brackets («пісень: 12»), which reads right for any number. The Trash is Смітник, as on a Mac; System Settings pages use Apple's Ukrainian names.
